name: Giant Defy Advanced SL 1
why_interesting: Exact-trim public notes and a current official 2026 reference establish the higher-tier Defy Advanced SL 1 separately from the existing Defy Advanced 2 candidate.
missing: Map the public-post bikes to the referenced 2026 official generation and reconcile the seatpost descriptions
Confirm the community-reported 7.4 kg complete weight with official or measured evidence
Current mainland CNY price, stock, purchase route and warranty

facts.drivetrain: 2026 official reference: SRAM Force AXS E1 electronic 2×12, 46/33 and 10-36
facts.brakes: 2026 official reference: SRAM Force E1 hydraulic disc, 160 mm
facts.frame: 2026 official reference: Advanced SL-grade composite with integrated seatpost
facts.frame_material: 2026 official global trim: Advanced SL-grade Composite frame and full-composite OverDrive Aero steerer; the exact fiber supplier and lay-up are not published
facts.frame_construction: Integrated seatpost and full-composite OverDrive Aero steerer on the 2026 official global trim; mapping the community bike to this generation remains unresolved
facts.stiffness_evidence: No measured or generation-bound exact-SL1 stiffness result was found; community ride impressions are not attached because the post does not establish the 2026 frame/build mapping
facts.sizes: S, M, M/L and L on the referenced UK page
facts.complete_weight_status: The official 2026 Australia page says each bike should be dealer-weighed because weight varies with size, finish, hardware and accessories; it publishes no numeric complete-bike weight and does not map the community-reported 7.4 kg bike to a year, size or build.
facts.price_status: No attributable current mainland CNY amount found after 50 registered source areas; the 2026-09-24 China Defy catalog and dealer-route recheck surfaced no exact SL 1 price, stock, or checkout.

support_note: Current Giant China policy offers lifetime coverage for general frames and 10-year coverage for non-suspension road forks sold from 2024-01-01, subject to mainland purchase/use, authorized-dealer sale and assembly, proof and exclusions. The community bike's model year, China invoice, dealer assembly and warranty-card status remain unknown, so this is conditional brand support rather than confirmed coverage for that build.
source_note:
The current official locator remains a generic brand route. No public exact-model dealer listing, stock or price was found; current mainland purchase route remains unresolved.

Batch 35 recheck: Giant UK's 2026 SL 1 trim specifies Advanced SL-grade Composite and a full-composite OverDrive Aero steerer. This supports the 2026 UK trim only; it does not identify the community-reported bicycle or establish a China-market mapping.

Batch 155 weight recheck: the official Australia 2026 Defy Advanced SL 1 page says dealers should weigh each bike because mass varies by size, finish, hardware and accessories; no numeric value is supplied. This does not map the community-reported 7.4 kg bike to a specific generation, size or configuration. See giant-defy-advanced-sl1-australia-official-weight-recheck-2026-09-25.
price_status: No current mainland exact-model price, stock, or checkout found in the 2026-09-24 official catalog and dealer-route recheck.
